description: This file implements the IpcClient class and related singleton accessors for IPC communication within the firebolt::rialto::client namespace. It manages connection, disconnection, and thread handling for IPC channels, and provides factory methods for creating blocking closures and RPC controllers.

classes.name: IIpcClientAccessor
classes.description: Interface providing singleton access to the IpcClient instance.

classes.name: IpcClient
classes.description: Manages IPC channel connection, disconnection, and threading for client communication.

methods.name: IIpcClientAccessor::instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IIpcClientAccessor.

methods.name: IIpcClientAccessor::getIpcClient
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton IpcClient.

methods.name: IpcClient::IpcClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IPC client and attempts connection.

methods.name: IpcClient::~IpcClient
methods.description: Destructor that attempts to disconnect the IPC client.

methods.name: IpcClient::connect
methods.description: Establishes IPC connection, sets up the IPC thread, and handles environment variables for socket configuration.

methods.name: IpcClient::disconnect
methods.description: Gracefully disconnects the IPC channel and joins the IPC thread.

methods.name: IpcClient::processIpcThread
methods.description: Runs in a separate thread to process IPC events and handle disconnection.

methods.name: IpcClient::getChannel
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the current IPC channel.

methods.name: IpcClient::createBlockingClosure
methods.description: Creates a blocking closure, choosing between poll or semaphore based on thread context.
